rule: A run is excluded when the one-minute load average at its start or end was above 4, the threshold the driver waits for before starting a run. The rule was set after the sweep, when the first repetition's ranges showed the disturbance. A replacement repetition made later the same day met the same load from other work and is excluded by the same rule, so LyEve's scenario figures are the median of three clean runs and each competitor's of four.
